children: gains 2.1% pre-market Wednesday after saying it agreed to

100% of the Turner copper-gold deposit in Oregon from Gold Coast Mining for as much as $38.7M, comprised of $4.7M in cash, $27M in Blue Moon shares, and up to $7M in milestone payments tied to permitting and production achievements.
Turner is a past-producing volcanic massive sulfide deposit located near the border between Oregon and California, and Blue Moon
said the deposit type and associated metals are similar to its Blue Moon mine located near Mariposa, California, which the company is currently advancing.

said it will explore potential synergies between Turner and the Blue Moon mine, with plans to develop a preliminary economic assessment by year-end 2027 that would include both deposits with a proposed 1,800 tons/day mill at its Springer complex in Nevada.
In the meantime, the company said it will initiate permitting for exploration drilling and underground development at Turner, which is expected to take 12-18 months.
